sections.description:
Transform Your WordPress Image Workflow Forever

AI Thumbnails Maker is a powerful all-in-one solution for automatic featured image generation and intelligent thumbnail management. Whether you’re managing a blog, running an e-commerce store, or operating a news website, this plugin streamlines your entire image workflow with cutting-edge automation.

Say goodbye to manually setting featured images for every post. Our intelligent thumbnail generator automatically creates stunning visuals using 5 advanced methods including AI-powered generation, making your content more engaging and professional—effortlessly.

🚀 Real-World Use Cases

Bloggers & Content Creators
Automatically generate eye-catching featured images from content or titles. Every post looks professional and drives more clicks instantly.

E-Commerce Stores
Perfect for WooCommerce stores. Auto-generate product thumbnails during bulk imports. Save hours of manual work.

News & Magazine Sites
Publish breaking news faster. Our post thumbnail automation finds images instantly or creates custom title cards on the fly.

Content Migration
Imported thousands of posts? Process your entire library in minutes with bulk generation. Every post gets a professional thumbnail automatically.

Social Media Optimization
Create share-optimized featured images for Facebook, Twitter, and LinkedIn. Consistent branding across all platforms.

Developers & Agencies
Manage multiple client sites efficiently. Force regenerate thumbnails after theme changes. Maintain consistency across all projects.

Multilingual Sites
AI-powered generation supports multiple languages, creating culturally relevant images for global audiences.

💎 Powerful Features

  • 5 Generation Methods – Content images, AI creation, title graphics, smart fallback, default image
  • AI Integration – OpenAI DALL-E 3 for unique, contextual image generation
  • Title Image Creator – Custom graphics with live preview and full customization
  • Smart Dashboard – Real-time statistics with Chart.js and bulk operations
  • Force Regenerate – Rebuild all thumbnail sizes after theme or settings changes
  • Auto-Generation – Automatically set featured images when publishing posts
  • Bulk Processing – Generate or delete thousands of thumbnails with progress tracking
  • Quality Control – Set minimum image dimensions and validation rules
  • Post Type Support – Works with posts, pages, WooCommerce products, custom types
  • Admin Preview – See featured images directly in posts list
  • Activity Logging – Detailed logs with image dimensions and file sizes
  • Overwrite Protection – Choose to preserve or update existing featured images
  • WordPress Standards – Clean code following official guidelines

🎨 Generation Methods Explained

1. First Content Image (Free)
Automatically scans your post content and selects the first suitable image that meets your quality requirements. Perfect for blogs and news sites where articles already contain relevant images. Smart detection ensures only high-quality images become featured thumbnails. No API keys or external services required.

2. AI Generation with OpenAI DALL-E (Optional)
Create completely unique, contextual images using cutting-edge AI technology. The plugin analyzes your post content (title, paragraphs, or full text) and generates a detailed prompt using GPT models (GPT-4, GPT-4o, or GPT-4o-mini). DALL-E then creates a custom image matching your content perfectly. Choose from natural or vivid styles, resolutions up to 1024×1792, and multiple language options. Requires OpenAI API key (costs ~$0.04-$0.08 per image).

3. Generate from Title (Free)
Transform post titles into professional custom graphics with text overlays. Fully customize width, height, background color, text color, and font size. The real-time live preview shows exactly how your thumbnail will look before generating. Perfect for social media sharing and maintaining consistent branding. Uses local GD Library—no external services needed.

4. Search or Generate (Free)
Smart fallback strategy that combines the best of both worlds. First attempts to find a suitable image in your post content. If none found, automatically generates a custom title-based graphic. Ensures every post gets a featured image without manual intervention. Ideal for mixed content where some posts have images and others don’t.

5. Use Default Image (Free)
Professional fallback system using a preset image from your WordPress media library. When no suitable image is found in content, the plugin automatically uses your chosen default. Perfect for maintaining consistent branding across posts without images. Great for podcasts, text-heavy content, or specific categories.

🏆 Why Choose AI Thumbnails Maker?

Effortless Automation
Stop wasting time manually setting featured images. Our intelligent post thumbnail automation handles everything automatically, freeing you to focus on creating great content.

Professional Results
Whether using AI generation or traditional methods, every thumbnail looks polished and professional. Your site will have that premium, well-maintained appearance that builds trust with visitors.

Complete Flexibility
With 5 different generation methods, you’re never locked into one approach. Switch strategies anytime, combine methods, or use different approaches for different post types.

Cost-Effective Solution
4 out of 5 generation methods are completely free. Only AI generation requires an optional OpenAI API key—and even that creates unlimited unique images for pennies per image.

Built for Scale
Managing 10 posts or 10,000? Our bulk processing handles any size library efficiently. Force regenerate thumbnails across your entire site in minutes, not hours.

Developer Friendly
Clean, well-documented code following WordPress standards. Extensive hooks and filters for customization. Modern build process with Vite and SCSS.

🔌 Our Other Plugins

SmartyPress AI Engine – Powerful AI integration for WordPress with ChatGPT and Deepseek. Generate high-quality content directly in Gutenberg editor with Magic Wand inline editing and AI Content Generator panel. Create titles, articles, excerpts with 10+ pre-built actions or custom prompts.

AdsDestroyer – Transform your WordPress admin into a clean, distraction-free workspace. Remove unwanted notices, promotional banners, and clutter with visual selection. Perfect for maintaining focus and creating professional client experiences.

Unnotifier — disable admin notices individually – Take complete control over WordPress admin notifications. Hide, customize, or remove any admin notice with precision. Essential for agencies managing multiple client sites or power users who value a clean interface.

💡 Inspired By Industry Leaders

We studied the best WordPress thumbnail and featured image plugins to bring you the most comprehensive solution:

  • Auto Post Thumbnail – Pioneer in automatic featured image generation from content
  • Quick Featured Images – Excellent bulk management and filtering capabilities
  • Easy Add Thumbnail – Intuitive user interface for thumbnail assignment
  • Regenerate Thumbnails – Industry standard for rebuilding thumbnail sizes
  • Default Featured Image – Smart fallback image functionality

We’ve combined the best features from these proven solutions and added powerful new capabilities like AI generation, title-based creation, and advanced automation that go far beyond what’s currently available.

🛠️ Requirements

  • WordPress 6.2 or higher
  • PHP 8.0 or higher
  • GD Library (included with most hosting)
  • OpenAI API key (optional, only for AI generation)

External Services

This plugin can optionally use OpenAI DALL-E 3 API for AI-powered image generation. This is completely optional – the plugin works perfectly without it using 4 free generation methods.

OpenAI DALL-E 3 API (Optional)

Service Provider: OpenAI, Inc. (https://openai.com)

When Used: Only when you:
* Select “AI Generation (OpenAI)” as your generation method
* Configure a valid OpenAI API key in settings
* Manually or automatically trigger thumbnail generation

Data Sent:
* Text prompts generated from post titles and/or content
* API authentication (your API key)
* Image parameters (size, style, resolution)
* NO personal data, visitor information, or sensitive content

Privacy & Terms:
* OpenAI Terms of Service
* OpenAI Privacy Policy
* API Documentation
* Pricing Information

Your Control:
* AI services disabled by default
* 4 completely free alternative methods available
* Switch methods anytime in settings
* No data sent if AI generation not configured
* All images stored locally in WordPress

GDPR Compliance:
* No visitor data processed
* Only admin users trigger API calls
* Complete transparency in data usage
* Delete all data by removing plugin

Privacy & Data Protection

Your Data Stays Private

AI Thumbnails Maker respects your privacy and follows WordPress best practices:

  • No Tracking – We don’t collect any usage data or analytics
  • No External Calls – Except optional OpenAI API when you explicitly enable AI generation
  • Local Storage – All generated images and logs stored in your WordPress database
  • Complete Control – You decide what data (if any) is sent to external services
  • GDPR Compliant – No personal data processing of your visitors
  • Transparent – Full disclosure of when and what data is transmitted

When using AI generation, only text prompts are sent to OpenAI. Review our External Services section for complete details.

Support & Documentation

Need Help?

  • What’s New Page – Visit AI Thumb Maker → What’s New for feature documentation
  • Support Forum – Get help on WordPress.org
  • Settings Help – Each setting includes detailed inline descriptions
  • Video Guides – Check our website for tutorial videos (coming soon)

Report Bugs or Request Features

Found a bug? Have an idea for improvement? We’d love to hear from you! Visit our support forum or contact us through the plugin.

Built With Excellence

  • Chart.js for beautiful data visualization
  • OpenAI API integration for AI capabilities
  • Modern JavaScript (ES6+) and SCSS
  • Vite for lightning-fast asset compilation
  • Follows WordPress coding standards

Special Thanks

To the WordPress community, OpenAI, and all the developers whose plugins inspired us to create the most comprehensive thumbnail solution available.

Developers

Contributing

Development happens on GitHub. Pull requests welcome!

Code Quality
* WordPress Coding Standards (WPCS) compliant
* Object-oriented PHP 8.0+ architecture
* Modern JavaScript with jQuery integration
* BEM methodology for CSS
* Comprehensive inline documentation
* Automated build process with quality checks

Hooks & Filters

Extensive customization options for developers:
* aitm_generation_methods – Add custom generation methods
* aitm_ai_models – Register additional AI services
* aitm_image_quality – Modify quality validation logic
* aitm_thumbnail_sizes – Customize registered sizes
* And many more documented in code

Roadmap

Coming Soon

  • Additional AI services (Stable Diffusion, Midjourney)
  • Advanced image style presets and templates
  • Smart image analysis and content recognition
  • Batch optimization tools for large sites
  • Enhanced caching for better performance
  • Custom prompt templates library
  • A/B testing for thumbnail effectiveness
  • Integration with popular page builders
  • Advanced analytics and reporting
  • Mobile app for management on-the-go

Your Feedback Matters

Help shape the future of AI Thumbnails Maker! Share your ideas and feature requests in our support forum.

Transform your WordPress image workflow today with AI Thumbnails Maker – the ultimate auto featured image and thumbnail generator solution.
sections.installation:
Automatic Installation (Recommended)

  1. Log in to your WordPress admin panel
  2. Navigate to Plugins > Add New
  3. Search for “AI Thumbnails Maker”
  4. Click “Install Now” then “Activate”
  5. Go to AI Thumb Maker in your admin menu to start

Manual Installation

  1. Download the plugin ZIP file
  2. Go to Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin
  3. Choose the ZIP file and click “Install Now”
  4. Click “Activate Plugin”

Quick Start Guide

  1. Configure Settings – Visit AI Thumb Maker → Settings

    • Choose your preferred generation method
    • Enable automatic generation
    • Select which post types to process

  2. Customize Options (Optional)

    • Set minimum image quality requirements
    • Configure AI settings if using AI generation
    • Customize title image appearance with live preview

  3. Generate Thumbnails

    • Go to Auto Featured Image dashboard
    • View statistics and select post type
    • Click “Generate Thumbnails” for bulk processing

  4. Regenerate Sizes (Optional)

    • Visit Regenerate Thumbs for thumbnail size management
    • Select options and click “Regenerate” to rebuild all sizesSee the Installation tab above for detailed setup instructions.
sections.faq:
Is AI generation required to use this plugin?

No! AI generation is completely optional. The plugin offers 4 free methods that work without any API keys:
* First Content Image (finds images in your content)
* Generate from Title (creates custom title graphics)
* Search or Generate (smart combination)
* Use Default Image (fallback from media library)

Only choose AI generation if you want to create completely unique images using DALL-E.

How much does AI generation cost?

OpenAI DALL-E 3 costs approximately $0.040-$0.080 per image depending on size and quality. Other methods are completely free. You only pay OpenAI directly through your own API account.

Will this automatically generate featured images for new posts?

Yes! Enable “Auto Generation” in settings, select your post types, and choose a generation method. Every new post will automatically get a featured image when published.

Can I use this with WooCommerce products?

Absolutely! The plugin supports all post types including WooCommerce products. Perfect for automatically generating product thumbnails during bulk imports.

What happens if no suitable image is found?

It depends on your chosen method:
* First Content Image – Post remains without featured image
* Search or Generate – Automatically creates title-based image
* Use Default Image – Uses your preset fallback image
* AI Generation – Creates unique image from content

Will it overwrite my existing featured images?

By default, no. The plugin only generates featured images for posts without them. Enable “Overwrite Existing Featured Images” in settings if you want to replace existing thumbnails.

How do I force regenerate thumbnails after changing themes?

Go to AI Thumb Maker → Regenerate Thumbs, select your options (regenerate all, skip existing, delete old), and click “Start Regeneration”. The tool rebuilds all registered thumbnail sizes automatically.

Does this work with Gutenberg blocks?

Yes! The plugin intelligently parses both classic editor content and Gutenberg blocks to find images. Works seamlessly with all WordPress editors.

Can I customize the generated title images?

Definitely! When using “Generate from Title” method, customize:
* Image dimensions (width × height)
* Background color
* Text color
* Font size
* Real-time live preview shows exactly how it will look

Is my data safe when using AI generation?

Yes. Only text prompts (derived from your post titles/content) are sent to OpenAI. No personal data, user information, or sensitive content is ever transmitted. Generated images are stored in your WordPress media library.

Does this slow down my website?

No! The plugin only processes images in the WordPress admin area using background AJAX. Your website frontend performance is completely unaffected.

Can I see which posts have featured images?

Yes! The plugin adds a thumbnail preview column to your posts list, giving you instant visual overview of your featured image coverage.

How do I bulk generate thumbnails for existing posts?

  1. Go to AI Thumb Maker → Auto Featured Image
  2. Select post type from the filter
  3. View statistics showing posts with/without featured images
  4. Click “Generate Thumbnails” to process all posts automatically
  5. Monitor real-time progress and view detailed logs

What image formats are supported?

All standard WordPress formats: JPEG, PNG, GIF, WebP, and more. AI-generated images are returned as PNG for maximum quality.
